title: suck_pull and mbox duplicate NNTP response_code parser
description: crates/transit/src/import/suck_pull.rs, import/ihave_push.rs, and import/mbox.rs each define a private 3-digit NNTP response code parser (parse_response_code / response_code / mbox_response_code). These are structurally identical functions. Extract one canonical function to stoa_core or an import utility module and delete the duplicates.
